# @three-ws/motion

> Text and structure to full-body 3D animation. A Motion Score in, a three.js AnimationClip out: forward and inverse kinematics, balance, ground contact and secondary motion in plain JavaScript, with no mocap data, no model weights and no renderer.

@three-ws/motion is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/motion`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-motion/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-motion/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-motion/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-motion/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
